:::{#def-function}
#### Function

A **function** $f$ from a set $A$ to a set $B$,
written $f : A \to B$,
assigns to each element $a \in A$
exactly one element $f(a) \in B$.

- The element $a \in A$ is called the **argument** (or **input**) to $f$.
- The assigned element $f(a) \in B$ is called the **value** (or **output**) of $f$ at $a$.

A function is also called a **map** (or *mapping*)
or a **transformation**;
on this site the three words mean the same thing,
although some authors reserve "transformation"
for a function from a set to itself.

:::
